summary.text: Mallory Martin is the Democratic candidate for the Colorado House of Representatives, District 54, in the November 3, 2026 general election, in which she faces Republican Jason Bias.
She advanced from the June 30, 2026 Democratic primary and says her campaign centers on affordability, healthcare, agriculture and public lands, democracy and education.

paragraphs.text: Mallory Martin says on her campaign website that she grew up in Colorado as the daughter of a construction worker and a teacher and is a long-time resident of House District 54.
The site describes her as having a background in healthcare and community advocacy.

Her listed priorities include lowering the cost of housing, utilities and everyday essentials, keeping rural clinics and hospitals open, supporting farms, ranches and public lands, protecting fair elections, and supporting public schools, career training and funding for preschool and college.
